title: Concept: Customer selfie capture reference in a response
description: A selfie field that carries an image URL or inline data in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The selfie is the liveness evidence for an account, so a response that returns it hands over the exact image an impersonator would replay to pass a weaker check elsewhere.
